name: Prometheus
introduce:
SAT-47SC 盗火者
希德制造主导研发的第三世代轻型机兵，主要列装于晨星同盟防卫军及监察委员会。
作为希德制造进军高端轻型机兵领域的代表机型，盗火者的设计摒弃了公司一直以来重视火力与性价比的理念，不惜成本使用质量更轻强度更高的新型钢岚合金框架，以及试验型战斗辅助综合系统「裂解核心」，并搭配AI动态机能管制设计，使其能以较低的整体能耗兼顾战场数据搜集和精准火力瞬时释放，从而高效打击高价值目标。无论从技术参数还是实战结果来看，盗火者都是一部适合长时间单兵特种作战任务的优秀机兵。

20534.name: Heartsplitter Mod
20534.SpecificEffects: During combat, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff the target carries, increases own DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and target DMG taken by <color=#F74848>2%</color>, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

30438.name: Aggression Mod
30438.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, critical hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color>. If the attack does not score a critical hit, the next attack critical hit chance increases by additionally <color=#F74848>15%</color>. This effect is reset upon scoring a critical hit. When entering <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode, the attack multiplier is increased by <color=#F74848>+0.1</color>.
